overview: HMAGAT proposes a hypergraph neural network-based imitation learning framework for Multi-Agent Path Finding that replaces pairwise GNN message passing with directed hypergraph attention to explicitly model group interactions, achieving state-of-the-art performance with ~1% of the training data and ~1.2% of the parameters compared to prior work.

modules.name: Observation Tensor Builder
modules.description: Constructs the local observation tensor for each agent, consisting of four channels: obstacle map, agent map, goal direction projection, and normalized cost-to-go map, centered on the agent's position within the field-of-view radius.

modules.name: CNN Observation Encoder
modules.description: Implements the convolutional encoder that converts the 4-channel local observation tensor into a node feature embedding for each agent, serving as the initial representation fed into the hypergraph attention layers.

modules.name: Hypergraph Generation Engine
modules.description: Implements the three directed hypergraph construction strategies: Lloyd-based colouring with soft boundaries via Voronoi partitioning, k-means-based colouring with diffusion and soft boundary reassignment, and shortest distance-based clique construction. Each strategy produces directed hyperedges with singleton heads and multi-node tails, along with hyperedge feature vectors encoding relative position and Manhattan distance.

modules.name: Hypergraph Attention Network Layer
modules.description: Implements the core HGNN message-passing layer performing three-stage communication: tail-to-hyperedge aggregation with attention-weighted node embeddings and hyperedge features, hyperedge representation computation, and hyperedge-to-head attention-weighted message aggregation. Includes two softmax-normalized attention mechanisms for tail node selection and hyperedge selection by head nodes.

modules.name: MLP Action Decoder
modules.description: Implements the decoder that maps the final node embeddings from the stacked HGNN layers to an action distribution over candidate target vertices, outputting per-agent action logits for sampling.

modules.name: HMAGAT Full Model Assembly
modules.description: Assembles the complete HMAGAT pipeline by sequentially composing the CNN encoder, stacked HGNN layers, and MLP decoder. Manages forward propagation from raw observation tensors and communication hypergraphs to action distributions, handling the flow of node features and hyperedge representations across layers.

modules.name: Instance and Expert Data Generator
modules.description: Implements the instance generation pipeline using the POGEMA toolkit with configurable obstacle types, map sizes, and agent counts. Orchestrates expert trajectory collection using the lacam3 solver with staged timeout strategies, producing demonstration data for imitation learning.

modules.name: MAPF Dataset and DataLoader
modules.description: Implements a custom dataset class for loading expert MAPF trajectories, extracting per-agent observations and actions at each timestep. Handles batching of variable-sized agent groups, dynamic hypergraph construction per batch, and padding/collation strategies for efficient training.

modules.name: Main Training Loop
modules.description: Implements the primary imitation learning training loop with cross-entropy loss, AdamW optimization, epoch management, gradient handling, and checkpointing. Manages the staged training from initial expert data through online expert phases, including success rate tracking and quality-based data filtering.

modules.name: Online Expert Data Aggregator
modules.description: Implements the on-demand dataset aggregation mechanism to mitigate distributional shift. Tracks model failures during rollouts, extracts intermediate instances where the model deviates from expert quality, and solves them with lacam3 using staged timeouts to augment the training buffer with corrective trajectories.

modules.name: Post-Training Quality Improvement
modules.description: Implements the post-training phase that runs online expert quality improvement across all instances after achieving sufficient accuracy. Manages the mixed training ratio of quality improvement instances to pre-collected instances, with epoch-level online expert calls and trajectory length comparison for selective augmentation.

modules.name: Temperature Sampling RL Module
modules.description: Implements the actor-critic reinforcement learning module for dynamic softmax temperature prediction. The actor predicts per-agent temperature based on local observability, log-odds, and goal information; the critic estimates instance-level value. Trained with PPO to calibrate model confidence and improve action sampling.

modules.name: PIBT Collision Shielding Wrapper
modules.description: Implements the Priority Inheritance with Backtracking (PIBT) collision shielding that wraps around the learned policy during inference. Intercepts the model's action distribution outputs and resolves vertex and edge collisions, ensuring physically feasible actions while respecting the model's preferences.

modules.name: Evaluation Metrics Suite
modules.description: Implements all core evaluation metrics: success rate (all agents reaching goals), relative sum-of-costs (Rel. SoC) with respect to the lacam3 baseline with penalty assignment for failed agents, and per-map runtime measurement. Includes statistical computation for 95% confidence intervals across instances.

modules.name: Ablation and Attention Analysis Framework
modules.description: Implements the ablation study infrastructure for incremental component addition (GNN→HGNN→online expert→post-training→temperature sampling). Provides attention score extraction and analysis tools including coefficient of variation computation, normalized entropy calculation, Shapley value estimation for influence ranking, and hand-crafted scenario construction for attention dilution and group interaction verification.

modules.name: Benchmark Evaluation Runner
modules.description: Implements the full benchmark evaluation pipeline across all map categories (Sparse/Dense Maze, Empty/Dense Room, Dense Warehouse, ost003d, lak303d, Paris, Berlin) with configurable agent counts. Manages multi-method comparison (MAGAT, MAPF-GPT variants, SSIL, SCRIMP, DCC), hyperparameter sensitivity sweeps, and automated result aggregation with radar plots and confidence interval visualization.
